devtools.name: Developer tools
devtools.running: {{.App}} is running and uses these files. Quit {{.App}} first.
devtools.version_running: This version of {{.App}} is running right now. Restart {{.App}} so it switches to the current version.
devtools.claude_app: Claude manages this folder itself; deleting parts of it can lose sessions. Clean it in Claude › Settings › This computer › Storage.
devtools.claude_history: Conversation history of Claude Code. To remove old sessions automatically, set cleanupPeriodDays in ~/.claude/settings.json.
devtools.leftovers.title: Leftovers of uninstalled apps
devtools.leftovers.what: Extensions, settings, caches and data of editors and tools that are no longer on this Mac — for example VS Code or IntelliJ IDEA moved to the Trash.
devtools.leftovers.why: The app itself is gone, so nothing uses these files.
devtools.leftovers.after: If you install the app again, it starts with default settings and without extensions.
devtools.old_versions.title: Old versions
devtools.old_versions.what: Previous versions kept after updates: Claude Code and Cursor CLI builds, old extension versions, settings folders of previous JetBrains and Android Studio versions.
devtools.old_versions.why: The current version doesn't use them. A version that is still running can't be selected.
devtools.old_versions.after: Nothing changes for the current version.
devtools.caches.title: Caches and temporary files
devtools.caches.what: Web caches, compiled code of previous app versions, extension installers, logs and temporary files of editors and AI tools.
devtools.caches.why: Apps recreate them. Settings, chats and project state are in other folders and are not touched. Caches of running apps can't be selected.
devtools.caches.after: The first start after cleaning is a little slower.
devtools.runtimes.title: Downloaded runtimes
devtools.runtimes.what: Tools that AI apps download to work with files on your Mac, for example the Codex runtime with Node.js and LibreOffice.
devtools.runtimes.why: The app downloads the runtime again when it needs it.
devtools.runtimes.after: The next task that needs it waits for a download of 1–2 GB.
devtools.info.title: Cleaned inside the app
devtools.info.what: Data that these apps manage themselves: shown here so you can see how much space it takes.
devtools.info.why: Deleting it from outside can break the app or lose your history, so it can't be selected here.
devtools.info.after: Use the place mentioned in each line to clean it the right way.
